title: iberis prostii subsp. violletii
intro: Iberis prostii subsp. violletii, commonly known as Alpine Rose or Rock Cress, is a flowering plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Iberis prostii subsp. violletii include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as isothiocyanates and glucosinolates. The bioactive constituents of Iberis prostii subsp. violletii have been shown to possess potential therapeutic applications in the prevention and treatment of various diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular diseases.
